risk_note: RV2 settlement + app.module (B2-04ze; D10-443; BR-FUND-04, BR-FUND-20). SettlementModule.forWorker registers bill and batch_execute on the existing settle queue (exclusive, singletonKey) and, in the worker entry only, starts a daily bill seed (apps × union platforms; not-due days answered by the job) and a due-batch scan (CONFIRMED with scheduled_at reached, and EXECUTING for take-over), judged by queue / table state, stopped on module destroy. app.module wires createBillJob, createBatchExecutor, createCreditOrder and createBeneficiaryCredit with readAttribution = commission.readCommissionAttribution, the BeneficiaryGate (identity users lock, realname / deletion readers, risk state reader, B1-03zc minors) and commission appendBeneficiaryEvent through a thin adapter. FU-B204ZD-SNAPSHOT: bill readSource is one statement. Switches unchanged: settle.auto.enabled default on, credit.enabled.<platform> default off, so production credits nothing by default.
